maria: quick check — I'm running the streaming + function-call benchmark and seeing ~18-22% p50 regression vs non-streaming for short prompts. repro command below, results pasted. anyone seen this?

maria: command I used: `./bench/run_stream.sh --model redwood-11b-8bit --concurrency 8 --reps 100 --stream true --tool-calls 1`

maria: results (summary):
```
non-stream p50=260ms p95=420ms
stream + toolcall p50=320ms p95=510ms
delta ~+60ms (23%) at p50
CPU avg 58% per worker, GPU util ~74%
```

dan: can you include whether kv-cache was warm or cold and the exact build sha? also which quant flags? :eyes:

maria: kv-cache was cold, build sha `a1b2c3d`, quant flags `--quant 8bit` (xformers off). I can run warm tomorrow.

oliver: hm — a couple of things to try before we dig in: 1) streaming flush interval defaults to per-token in that script, try `--stream-chunk=4` or `--stream-batch=16` to reduce syscall overhead. 2) confirm if the tool-callback path does an extra memcpy/serialize on the critical path (we had a PR which added a copy for safety).

oliver: quick command to reproduce locally (fast): `python3 perf_tool.py --mode=stream --model redwood-11b-8bit --chunk 4 --reps 200 --concurrency 4`

anya: for toolcall overhead, serialization + callback scheduling often adds ~8-12ms per call. If you can grab a timeline from the runtime debug endpoint that helps. e.g. `/debug/timeline?format=txt&limit=200` — paste snippet. :thumbsup:

maria: pasted small timeline snippet below (abbreviated):
```
[0.000s] request start
[0.012s] token0 generated -> stream flush (user send)
[0.015s] tool callback serialize
[0.077s] tokenize next chunk
[0.320s] response end
```
Seems like serialize+flush cluster around 10-80ms window per request.

dan: thanks — can you run one warm-cache run and one cold-cache run and attach both timelines? also include `--stream-chunk` variants. I'll run a quick perf with pprof attached on my side tomorrow morning.

maria: will do. filed a small ticket so we don't lose this: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/RINF-987 — assigned to @oliver, priority P2. linking here for context.

oliver: ack, I'll take a look. suspicion: added memcpy in stream encoder path in PR #4521 (we did that to fix a memory-safety corner case). If that's the culprit we'll either make the copy lazy or batch until the chunk limit.

deploy-bot: nightly-bench finished — baseline (non-stream) vs stream toolcall job queued at 1778001200, artifacts at https://artifacts.redwood/bench/1778001200/overview.html

maria: thanks — I've queued warm-cold comparisons and will paste numbers when done. tagging @dan since you'll run pprof. :raised_hands:

dan: cool — ping me once the warm run finishes. I'll compare pprof cpu flamegraphs (look for big memcpy / SerializeJSON calls). If needed I'll instrument nvprof on GPU side but my bet is CPU-side serialization/locks.

maria: last note — if anyone else wants to repro quicker, use the perf docker we keep in infra: `docker run --rm -e MODEL=redwood-11b-8bit redwood/perf:latest ./run_local.sh --stream --chunk 2 --reps 50`

oliver: thanks all — will update RINF-987 with my findings.

maria: :thumbsup:
